query:
select distinct
                g.id, g.path, false as "limit_membership_visibility!",
                g.stock_tracking as "stock_tracking!",
                g.parent_members_can_join as "parent_members_can_join!",
                g.propogate_member_visibility_access as "propagate_member_visibility_access!",
                g.name as "name!: DIS",
                g.description as "description!: DIS",
                g.deleted,
                logo.id as logo_id,
                logo.url as logo_url,
                (select array(select user_id from group_adminships where group_id = g.id)) as admin_ids
            from groups g
            join group_memberships gm on gm.user_id = $1
            join groups mg on mg.id = gm.group_id
            join images logo on logo.id = g.logo_id
            where subpath(g.path, 0, 1) = subpath(mg.path, 0, 1)
            and g.deleted = false
            order by g.path
